name: Ron (Rondo) Boozell
reasoning: In his own May 2026 Deschutes County voters' pamphlet statement (filed while running for County Commissioner Position 5, the cycle immediately before he qualified for the Bend mayoral race), Boozell wrote in his own words that local government should refuse ICE access, require a warrant before any cooperation, and conduct no immigration-related investigations. This is his most current dated statement on the topic and matches the strictest non-cooperation position on the scale (refuse all detainers/proactive assistance).

name: Ron (Rondo) Boozell
